question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**malpractices**" means illegal, improper, or unethical conduct by a person in a position of authority or trust. (अनैतिक आचरण)
 
• Example: Bribery and fraud are common malpractices that damage public trust.
 
• In the context of the passage, **"malpractices"** fits best as it refers to the illegal or unethical activities that some people might have indulged in, which the demonetization move sought to counter.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**' i.e. 'malpractices'.

**Complete Sentence:** *All the people but those who indulged in malpractices__ welcomed the move.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Indecision (अनिर्णय)**: inability to decide. 

 
 
• **Example:** Her indecision about the job offer caused her to miss the opportunity.
 
 
 
• **Announcement (घोषणा)**: a formal public statement about a fact, event, or intention. 
 
 
• **Example:** The company made an announcement about the upcoming merger.
 
 
 
• **Amalgamation (विलयन)**: the action, process, or result of combining or uniting. 
 
 
• **Example:** The amalgamation of the two departments improved efficiency.
